note: The About timeline, one entry per step. Write only title and summary (a new release line: one entry at the end, without release, commit or datetime); release:prepare stamps release, commit and datetime (scripts/about-stations.mjs --stamp), and the build derives the step number, the time shown, the (Vx.y) label and the done/current state.

stations.title: Plan
stations.summary: First tracked commit: rules and a 95-section plan

stations.title: V1
stations.summary: Single-file instrument, tagged v1.0.0

stations.title: V2
stations.summary: Modular acoustic laboratory at the end of the first night: 5 h 51 min of wall-clock time, with several AI workers in parallel

stations.title: Measure
stations.summary: Measurement architecture

stations.title: Studio
stations.summary: Composition and signal flow

stations.title: Review
stations.summary: Independent DSP review; Studio links and a derived Signal Path

stations.title: Navigate
stations.summary: Eight workspaces; every Studio review finding fixed

stations.title: Records
stations.summary: Release records; an About page the release gate keeps current

stations.title: Runtime
stations.summary: The Studio says what is running and why; plan identity and divergence

stations.title: Evidence
stations.summary: A completed experiment is immutable, each experiment has an identity, provenance names the exact build

stations.title: Comparison
stations.summary: Two experiments are compared by what changed between them, against a chosen baseline

stations.title: Trace
stations.summary: One edit followed from intent to the running graph: applied, stored or refused

stations.title: Definitions
stations.summary: An experiment is executed from a versioned definition and records which version it used

stations.title: Lineage
stations.summary: An experiment states what produced each value and what repeating it would need, from what it stored

stations.title: Findings
stations.summary: A finding cites the stored experiments it rests on, and a stored record links to the records connected to it

stations.title: Audit
stations.summary: The Studio passes its final review, and a deployed page names its release state: the release itself, or how far after it

stations.title: Minimap
stations.summary: The Studio graph shows a minimap of the whole patch, and the release scripts, size report and plan records hold what their checks claim

stations.title: Import
stations.summary: The Studio opens a V2 sequence or configuration file and refuses what it cannot read, the timeline zooms by pinch, and MIDI input states whether this browser supports it

stations.title: Synth
stations.summary: A Synth workspace plays its own engines from knobs, MIDI and the computer keys play the instrument, the Studio and the Synth, and the sequencer plays through the engine's counted Filter stage

stations.title: Phone
stations.summary: The instrument sounds on a phone and the gate proves it with the browser's gesture rule on, every key and Space go through one registry, and a release rests on the CI run of its own pull request

stations.title: Patches
stations.summary: The Synth plays from an XY pad, one patch library of presets serves the Synth and the Studio, and the page's Escape and Space go through the one key registry

stations.title: Riffs
stations.summary: The library offers original riffs to listen to and insert, the Synth gets its own look and a patch bay on the phone, presets and links restore the lab settings they name, and every control of every workspace is checked to round-trip

stations.title: Templates
stations.summary: Six synthesis templates join the Studio, a notes clip holds a melody as data, a fuzzy search finds a node by its meaning, the Studio keys work wherever the Studio is shown, and the Synth's code is reviewed like the Studio it drives

stations.title: Contracts
stations.summary: Every patch-bay port has a contract table derived from the registry, the Studio graph summary links each node, a node the running graph does not hold says why, and a refused Play stops the runtime and says so

stations.title: Hardware
stations.summary: The Synth's panel takes a hardware look from one synth-theme layer with its own visual reference, the XY pad lives on one shared mount and lets go on Stop and on leaving, the Arm button reads the transport and every keyboard disarms what it armed, and pull requests land through a merge queue

stations.title: Shell
stations.summary: The Pro admin shell with its sidebar and page header on every workspace, Related links, About and empty states driven by one workspace registry, one declaration per UI component, and the Synth's render budgets measured against the host it runs on

stations.title: Truth
stations.summary: About names only what each workspace shows, the release its roadmap describes and every library the page ships, the Sequencer's blocks stay readable at phone width, Play stops saying pressed when the sequence stops elsewhere, and a source pack feeds an LLM project

stations.title: Derived
stations.summary: Nothing is typed twice: the About timeline is data whose numbers the build derives, the roadmap names the build's own version, the Majordomus pin is written once, the counts in the docs follow the code, and opening the Synth leaves a fresh Studio clean

stations.title: Čeština
stations.summary: Nové texty aplikace jsou česky a anglických vět, které ještě ukazuje, po souborech jen ubývá: hlídá to pravidlo a test

stations.title: Noty a tempo
stations.summary: Pole frekvence v sekvenceru berou název noty a číslo MIDI, tempo mimo 20 až 300 BPM se odmítne s důvodem a ovladač tempa ukazuje načtenou hodnotu

stations.title: Klávesy a pad
stations.summary: Klávesy hrají hned v každé pracovní ploše a ve Studiu se dok sbalí, kde by zabral editor; XY pad zní při prvním dotyku a jeho osa Y řídí filtr; druhá úprava obálky za běhu zachová tu první a nota se vždy uvolní na nástroji, který ji převzal

stations.title: Uzel Keys
stations.summary: Uzel Keys je jediný zdroj not pro Synth i Studio: posílá přesnou výšku a gate na audio hodinách, klouže lineárně v přesném čase, drží rozsah kláves, noty mimo rozsah odmítne s důvodem a řekne, kde oscilátor drží výšku pod 0,95 × Nyquist

stations.title: Noty na audio hodinách
stations.summary: Notes clipy hrají na uzlu Keys na audio hodinách se swingem, ratchetem, slidem, seedovanou pravděpodobností a tap tempem; STOP nechá klávesy připravené a jejich hraní zní i při zastaveném transportu; hrané noty vlastní scope a stavový řádek a obnovený normal v Synthu se ohlásí
